authoring_metadata.author: executor (rule-derived starting point)
authoring_metadata.description: CHARACTER-AUDIT STARTING POINT, not a factory preset and not a recommendation. Values follow a fixed rule (LIGHT = +6 dB at the stage; HARD = +12 dB plus the +20 dB step; DUAL MEDIUM = +12/+12; trim = -(gain added) so an unclamped signal returns to unity). The owner auditions and changes them on real finished beats.
